metadata.name: MetaCraft - Automated OpenGraph & Social Card Engine
metadata.core_problem: Every blog post and tweet needs branded social cards, but manual Canva design is time-consuming.
metadata.solution: Dynamic client-side SVG-to-Canvas OG card generator with pre-made conversion-tested templates.

monetization.free_tier: Basic card templates with manual download.
monetization.pro_tier: $14 one-time for Pro Template Bundle + Programmatic URL Generator Script.

metadata.hosting_stack: Client-side Web App on GitHub Pages / Cloudflare Pages.
